content:
sam: starting a small canary for release v3.0.1 -> 8% in us-east at 09:03. deploy-bot acked. :rocket:
deploy-bot: Deploy started: release=v3.0.1 stage=canary target=8% initiated_by=sam
ria: quick FYI, increased memory working set on canary infer nodes, observed ~40MB -> 180MB over steady state on long prompts
devon: seeing a couple of soft-fails on large-context requests (client retries), 0.3% of requests returning 429-ish backpressure
priya: tagging release notes: /releases/v3.0.1 - includes disk-backed kv cache fallback and op fusion improvements
sam: are the canaries running the cache-fallback path? we expect different mem profile
devon: yes, canaries have kv-fallback enabled via flag cache.mode=fallback
ria: 5xx count is stable. CPU and GPU util fine, but p95 requester latency jumps when token lengths > 1k
priya: suggest holding to investigate correlation with cache eviction thresholds. we can pin routing to v3.0.0 while we look
sam: ok pausing traffic. deploy-bot, pause and pin stable to v3.0.0
deploy-bot: Traffic shift paused by sam at 09:07. Current traffic: canary=8%, stable=92%. Pinning stable route -> v3.0.0 (temp)
devon: leaving canary pods up for traces. collecting mmap and dmesg now. uploading to s3://redwood-debug/canary/1728888888/logs.tar.gz
ria: added a short alert suppression for p95 flaps for 20m to reduce noise
priya: we should add a note in release docs to mark kv fallback as opt-in until perf validated
sam: agree. also will update changelog with mitigation steps in case of memory climb
devon: small rollback plan outlined: 1) scale canary down to 1% 2) unpin stable after warm 3) rollback kv fallback flag in next small patch if needed
priya: infra note - if we need kernel tweaks infra may need 15m lead to coordinate; pinging infra channel now
sam: OK team. reconvene at 09:30 for a stop/go. owners: ria metrics, devon traces, priya release ops
ria: ack. running histogram split by token-length buckets :mag:
devon: ack. keeping span retention open and sampling at 50% for canary request ids
priya: prepping an emergency patch branch just in case, will post link when ready
deploy-bot: Reminder: change window for broad rollout is 10:00-12:00 EDT. Any rollback inside window requires eng-leads + oncall ok
sam: thanks. if all good at 09:30 we'll resume at 5% then 25% with strict canary gates. if mem climb persists we will proceed with rollback to v3.0.0 and cut incident notes
priya: patch branch ready: https://git.redwood/release/v3.0.1-hotfix-kvflag
ria: capture link: https://grafana/redwood/d/xyz/canary-metrics?orgId=1&var-canary=1728888888
devon: traces uploaded: https://traces.redwood/internal/trace/1728888888
sam: closing thread until stop/go. will post an explicit GO or ROLLBACK at 09:30. :white_check_mark:
